findings.location:
Divine Redeemer, Thee I bless;
I greet Thy going forth;
I love Thee in the loveliness
Of Thy renewed earth.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve the sense of 'going forth' more idiomatically in Indonesian. Suggest: "Aku menyambut keluarnya-Mu;" or better, to sound natural and retain the archaic/poetic tone, "Aku menyambut keluarmu itu;" or "Aku menyambut keluarmu, wahai Penebus." Keep punctuation and tags unchanged.
Use a more natural Indonesian rendering of 'fragrancy' to convey the poetic image. Suggest: "Dan keharuman doa!" or "Dan harumnya doa!" Preserve the HTML paragraph and line-break tags.

findings.location:
Creator Spirit, work in me
These wonders sweet of Thine;
Divine Redeemer, graciously
Renew this heart of mine.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an Indonesian imperative particle to match the English imperative tone. Suggest: "Roh Pencipta, kerjakanlah dalam diriku" (keeping other lines and tags unchanged).
